slides.label: Why now
slides.detail: The average worker gets about 117 emails a day (Microsoft Work Trend Index). From 10 November, Google began switching on Gemini summaries and Help me write for Workspace accounts.
slides.start: The rollout can take up to 15 days to reach you.

slides.label: Step 1: Switch on smart features
slides.detail: In Gmail on a computer, select the gear icon, then See all settings. On the General tab, make sure smart features are switched on, then save.
slides.start: Still nothing? Ask whoever manages your Workspace account.

slides.label: Step 2: Read the overview, not the thread
slides.detail: Open a long email chain. Gemini adds an AI Overview at the top: who asked for what, what was agreed, what is still open.
slides.start: Then read only the one message that matters.

slides.label: Step 3: Reply with Help me write
slides.detail: Select Reply, then Help me write, and paste:
slides.start: Nothing sends until you press Send.
slides.quote: Reply to [name]. Confirm we can do [job] on [date] for [price]. Ask them to confirm by [day]. Friendly, under 80 words.

slides.label: Step 4: Rough notes to email
slides.detail: Type it like a text: "can do tues not weds, price same, need deposit first". Once you pass about a dozen words, choose Polish. Gemini turns it into a tidy email.
slides.start: Formalise, Elaborate and Shorten sit alongside it.

slides.label: Step 5: Save three prompts
slides.detail: Chase a quote: friendly follow-up, no pressure, under 60 words. Say no: decline, give the reason, suggest an alternative. Move a booking: apologise once, offer a new date, ask them to confirm.
slides.start: Full wording for all three is on our blog.

slides.label: What it could give back
slides.detail: Save 15 minutes a day on threads you no longer read end to end and replies you no longer start from scratch. Five days a week, 48 weeks: about 60 hours a year. Illustrative, so time your own.
slides.start: The bigger win: the quote you chase on time.

slides.label: One thing to watch
slides.detail: Read every draft. Gemini only knows what is in the email, so it can sound surer about a date or price than you are. Free personal Gmail accounts got these tools in the US first.
